verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt served at apidocs.chargebee.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing the API v2 reference. The API and product docs are published as markdown (.md) pages, which agents can ingest directly; the .md.md 404 only reflects a doubled extension, not missing markdown docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or broader coverage beyond the API reference index.
